chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddaq ibn Sadaqa, from 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'How should a man sit when he intends to cleanse his private parts?' He said, 'Just as he sits for defecation.' And he said, 'He is only required to wash what is apparent from it, and he is not required to wash its inside.'

key_terms.مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهُ: what is apparent from it (the exterior)
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِيَ: to cleanse the private parts after defecation

ai.seo_question: How should one sit and what parts of the body need to be washed during istinja' according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the practical methodology for istinja', emphasizing that the cleaning process mirrors the natural posture of defecation. It clarifies the scope of the obligation, distinguishing between the external area requiring washing and the internal cavity, which is not subject to the same ritual cleansing requirement. This ruling reflects the Shia juristic principle of ease and practicality in personal hygiene rituals derived from the Prophet's household.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man intends to cleanse his private parts, how should he sit?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Just as he would sit for the defecation’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, upon him is that he washes what is apparent from it, and it is not upon him that he washes his inside’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan has narrated from Sahl from Musa ibn al-Qasim from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘A man wants to wash himself clean after using toilet. How should he sit?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘He sits just as he does when defecating.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘He only needs to wash the outside and not the inside.’”
